blocks.label: Task
blocks.body: Add rate limiting to the public API, 100 requests per minute per key

blocks.label: Context
blocks.body: Node 22, Fastify, Postgres via Drizzle, tests in Vitest.

blocks.label: Done means
blocks.body: npm test passes and curl -I returns 429 on the 101st call. Run it yourself before you report back, and quote the output.

blocks.label: Do not touch
blocks.body: Do not touch the auth middleware or any migration older than 0042.

blocks.label: Working method
blocks.body: Explore the relevant files first and tell me the plan before you edit anything. Implement in one pass, run the check, then report what changed and what you did not change.

notes: Effective instructions are short, self-contained and broadly applicable. Path-scoped .instructions.md files with applyTo frontmatter are the escape valve.
warnings: Do not write instructions that require looking something up externally, mandate tone, or set word limits.
Agent-file support varies by Copilot feature. Do not assume AGENTS.md is read everywhere.

variations.name: Add one example
variations.text: Paste a short example of exactly the answer you want. One example outperforms a paragraph describing the format.

variations.name: Name the reader
variations.text: Add who reads this and what they will do with it. It changes what the model chooses to include more than any other line.

variations.name: Ask for the objections
variations.text: Add: end with the three strongest objections to your own answer, and say which one you find hardest to dismiss.
